DHAKA, July 20, 2023 (BSS) - Minimizing various trade barriers, Bangladesh's export to India can grow by 300 percent if it can just fetch only one percent of total Indian imports, observed International Chamber of Commerce Bangladesh (ICCB).

In its quarterly news bulletin (April-June 2023 issue), ICCB mentioned that despite huge potential, bilateral trade between India and Bangladesh was only US$11 billion in FY22, out of which export from Bangladesh to India was only $1.27 billion.
